description: Seedance 2.0 AI is a cinematic video generation platform designed to transform text prompts or static images into high-quality 15-second clips. By leveraging advanced Seedance and Seedream models, the tool enables users to produce professional-grade visual content with synchronized audio. The system is built to handle complex creative workflows, including text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video transformations.
